messages:
mike (PM): quick check — post-launch report shows a small regresion in streaming edge cases and ~12 customer asks for improved prompt templates. do we patch first or fold into next minor?
anya (Eng): the streaming issue is a regression from the rollout (edge case when clients send chunked meta frames). repro is reliable, root cause is a race in the chunk assembler.
anya (Eng): estimated fix + test + canary = ~8 dev hours, low-risk patch.
luca (Design): templates requests are more UX work (copy + a few UI tweaks) and depend on PMs prioritizing examples. not urgent.
sophia (CS): several enterprise customers hit the streaming case (2 customers with automated pipelines). one is blocking their nightly jobs, escalated.
kevin (SRE): from infra side, a quick patch is fine. we can do canary on dedicated pool, rollout window ~30m. will monitor p99, error spikes.
mike (PM): sounds like a quick patch is feasible and reduces customer impact. my suggestion: ship hotfix for streaming regression now, put templates into wave-2 backlog unless biz asks force sooner.
anya (Eng): agree. will open hotfix branch and PR today. tagging @ci-bot for a fast pipeline.
ci-bot: pipeline triggered for branch hotfix/streaming-race — build started.
luca (Design): I'll draft 3 template variants and attach to the backlog item for wave-2.
sophia (CS): can we notify the two impacted customers with ETA? i'll draft notes once we have canary time.
mike (PM): decision: hotfix = ship-now, templates = wave-2. action items: 1) anya opens PR + deploy plan; 2) kevin schedules canary window 11–11:30 PST; 3) sophia customer comms; 4) luca adds template drafts to backlog.
anya (Eng): PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/inference/pull/4823 — please review.
kevin (SRE): canary scheduled for 11:05 PST. I'll post status in #eng-oncall during rollout.
sophia (CS): notif draft ready, will send after canary completes.
mike (PM): great — if canary looks clean we target full rollout + ops page update. wave-2 planning: add templates to 2-week cadence, owner: luca, estimate: 3 dev days + 1 design day.
luca (Design): noted, adding to sprint board now.
anya (Eng): quick note: the fix includes a minor bump to the streaming schema (backwards compatible), leaving changelog entry.
kevin (SRE): post-deploy checks: p50/p95/p99 token latency, error-rate, and inflight KV size. I'll add dashboards.
mike (PM): thanks team. if anything blocks the canary or we see regression, rollback plan: revert hotfix branch, notify customers, escalate.
sophia (CS): :thumbsup: will standby.
ci-bot: build succeeded — tests passed. ready for canary.
anya (Eng): merging now.
kevin (SRE): canary started — monitoring.
kevin (SRE): canary metrics look good after 12 minutes, no error spike.
kevin (SRE): full rollout initiated.
ci-bot: deploy completed to 3 regions.
kevin (SRE): full rollout healthy. closing incident candidate.
mike (PM): closing loop — hotfix shipped, customers notified, wave-2 backlog item created for templates (owner: luca). moving this thread to archive. :white_check_mark:
